selection.name: Serena [C02]
selection.role: On-demand symbol discovery, exact source retrieval and semantic references through supported language servers. Keep known-file reads direct.
selection.install_command:
uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent
serena init

basis.shows: The open-source LSP backend provides symbol lookup, source and referencing-symbol navigation. Language-server dependencies and capability coverage vary by language.
Documents MCP integration with both clients through serena setup claude-code and serena setup codex.
Default-branch commit dated 2026-09-30; repository is unarchived.
Public language-test execution: inspected Ubuntu batches passed, but the overall suite failed and the macOS native batch was cancelled. This is mixed CI evidence.
Recent WSL maintenance activity addresses mismatched Linux Node and Windows npm. WSL2 and macOS arm64 clean-install execution remains unverified.

selection.name: ast-grep [C09]
selection.role: On-demand structural pattern search through either agent's shell; use when syntax structure answers the question.

basis.shows: Documents tree-sitter AST matching, structural search and Linux installation. Its CLI complements semantic reference lookup without requiring a persistent graph index.
Release published 2026-08-31 with Linux x86_64 GNU and macOS arm64 artifacts.
Default-branch commit dated 2026-09-28; repository is unarchived.
Successful public NAPI build on 2026-10-01. This supports build health, not measured retrieval superiority.

not_selected.name: gitnexus
not_selected.reason: Relevant source/reference and graph workflows, but native Node installation contingencies and unmeasured graph setup costs leave its advantage unresolved. [Pinned README](https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/blob/ce79caaf86860957b85932cd12409179edb1d14a/README.md).

not_selected.name: scip, zoekt and universal-ctags
not_selected.reason: Useful components, but SCIP requires language indexers, Zoekt supplies indexed text search, and ctags supplies symbol tags; the assembled client path and total index costs remain unverified. [SCIP](https://github.com/scip-code/scip), [Zoekt](https://github.com/sourcegraph/zoekt), [ctags](https://github.com/universal-ctags/ctags).

not_selected.name: jCodeMunch
not_selected.reason: Strong byte-precise symbol retrieval and passing current harness CI, but find_references follows imports rather than all call sites, limiting complete reference answers. [README](https://github.com/jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp/blob/5804d7e77b423f6dd22218adcba370d2ea0c7c9c/README.md), [CI](https://github.com/jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp/actions/runs/36935907529).

not_selected.name: Glean
not_selected.reason: Rich source facts and cross-references, but its indexer/database/Angle-query pipeline has no inspected clean-install or client-integration advantage for this workload. [README](https://github.com/facebookincubator/Glean/blob/e36f1dcdd6abca9e6b4e487db04a48093886e3c9/README.md).

not_selected.name: claude-plugins-official
not_selected.reason: A distribution directory for separately installed plugins; the packet identifies no particular navigation plugin whose capabilities and cross-client fit were verified. [README](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/blob/ab024cdcfa7ca80be204acd4907656ba5a968589/README.md).

not_selected.name: CodeGraph
not_selected.reason: Strong optional graph contender: its architecture-question A/B reports lower processed-token cost but higher resident context; it does not settle exact-reference accuracy, known-source reads or total index costs. [README](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/blob/ec738ec7a322a680dae39a904194ce9271e6873f/README.md).

not_selected.name: codebase-memory-mcp
not_selected.reason: Strong optional native graph contender with broad type-aware resolution and both-client integration; reported savings and index timings do not establish a matched exact-answer advantage over the finalists. [README](https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/blob/cb7d937638f77fb67aacc39444f6a6709d217d51/README.md), [measurement guidance](https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/blob/cb7d937638f77fb67aacc39444f6a6709d217d51/docs/MEASURING_SAVINGS.md).

not_selected.name: token-savior
not_selected.reason: Upstream withdrew its benchmark after finding tool invocation in only one of 143 sessions; exact-source/reference fit and target-platform installation remain insufficiently verified. [Retraction](https://github.com/Mibayy/token-savior/commit/73e9c7f56fd7).

layers.deciding_comparison: The selections cover complementary symbol/reference and structural-pattern roles; no overall measured winner is established. On the WSL2 host, compare Serena, codebase-memory-mcp, CodeGraph and a configured SCIP/Zoekt/ctags arm using sealed questions with complete source/reference answers. Include known-file reads, overloads, aliases, dynamic dispatch and post-edit freshness. Measure answer correctness, reference precision/recall, cold build time, incremental update time, memory, latency and resident context. Permit graph indexing only for questions that need it. Repeat platform smoke tests on macOS arm64.
evidence_gaps: The required ctx_fetch_and_index page requests were rejected because approval policy is never. Upstream documents were read through the GitHub API; callable ctx_index/ctx_search handled indexed reads. Strict webpage-fetch verification remains incomplete.
Budget used: 30 GitHub API requests, including four batched GraphQL requests; five web-search queries; seven requested page fetches, all blocked.
The packet supplies no target-language distribution or completed head-to-head. Upstream architecture/token benchmarks and file-coverage metrics do not establish complete reference-answer accuracy.

All checked default branches had commits within 90 days. Latest releases verified include GitNexus v1.6.12, codebase-memory v0.11.0, jCodeMunch v1.108.322 and CodeGraph v1.6.1. Release, issue-resolution and platform checks remain incomplete for lower-ranked candidates.
SCIP was verified at its current scip-code/scip repository. Glean's null packet repository was provisionally mapped to facebookincubator/Glean.
Correction verified against codebase-memory's pinned README: its resolver is implemented in C and supports many languages; textual fallback applies to languages without its Hybrid LSP pass.
No target-host installation or benchmark was run. Latest codebase-memory checks were queued; CodeGraph's inspected head returned no completed checks. GPU capability does not decide this layer.
